_comment: Answers of the fake server for the demo diffs (scripts/generate-demo.ts). Each rule applies if the state contains the given text; the other questions get the default values: noul 0.02, choice on the first option (none for choices with a value, nothing for primary_concern), score level 0. The rizzo-provisional profile does not transform noul, so the numbers are already the ones the verdict compares. adds_tests is sent as the choice "how are tests missing?" with none first: P(none) = 0.01 means tests missing at 0.99, i.e. adds_tests = 0.01. touches_auth 0.78 on the middleware is above the escalation threshold: uncertain.diff goes to Claude (policy v2).
